summary: `aayu ready <feature>` (human-only) is Approve to build. One approval per Feature agrees its baselines, its budget, and every story listed then (Decision #903). A story is Ready only while that approval covers it. A story added or changed later needs a person's acknowledgment, `aayu ready <feature> --ack <stories>`. This is steps S8 and S9 of the core design (aayu core: the human-dependency engine, agreed by @rahulnakmol on 2026-10-21). This Feature replaces #878, which #903 folds into it.
